categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in passenger air transportation, including domestic and international flights, along with ancillary services such as cargo transport, in-flight sales, and ground handling. It also engages in aircraft leasing, aircraft maintenance, travel product sales, and related service businesses. The company has expanded into product brokerage, medical device sales, and health functional food sales to diversify revenue streams.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company operates a fleet of Airbus aircraft models (A320-200, A321-200, A321neo) and utilizes leasing contracts for aircraft acquisition. It manages flight operations with a focus on maximizing aircraft utilization and operational efficiency. Fuel procurement is based on contracts with major suppliers, with pricing linked to international benchmarks like MOPS. The company emphasizes operational safety and punctuality through internal management programs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual and corporate passengers using domestic and international air travel services, especially in the Busan/Yeongnam region. The company serves business travelers and leisure passengers, with a strong presence in regional routes such as Busan-Gimpo and expanding international routes to Japan and Southeast Asia. Additional customers include cargo clients and consumers purchasing in-flight products and ancillary services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with a strong regional base in Busan and Yeongnam, and has expanded its presence to major domestic airports including Gimpo, Jeju, and Incheon. Internationally, it maintains offices and sales channels in multiple Asian cities such as Tokyo, Osaka, Taipei, Hong Kong, Qingdao, Hanoi, and others, supporting its international flight operations and sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the air transportation supply chain, providing passenger and cargo transport services directly to end customers. It also manages upstream relationships through aircraft leasing and fuel procurement contracts, and midstream activities such as aircraft maintenance and ground handling services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding international routes, especially to Japan and Southeast Asia, increasing aircraft utilization, and introducing next-generation aircraft like the A321neo to enable mid-to-long-haul operations. The company focuses on enhancing operational safety, punctuality, and customer service differentiation. It pursues revenue diversification through new ancillary services and product sales, while maintaining cost efficiency and exploring sustainable growth opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through passenger ticket sales for domestic and international flights. Additional income streams include cargo transport fees, in-flight sales (duty-free and other products), ancillary service fees such as paid seat upgrades and excess baggage, and commissions from product brokerage and medical device sales. The company uses both direct sales channels (call centers, airport counters, online platforms) and indirect sales via domestic and international travel agencies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading regional low-cost carrier (LCC) in the Busan/Yeongnam area, holding the highest market share in domestic and international flights from Gimhae Airport. It competes with major full-service carriers like Korean Air and Asiana Airlines, as well as other LCCs in the Korean market. Its competitive advantages include operational safety, punctuality, regional market dominance, and customer service excellence, having won top rankings in major Korean customer satisfaction indices.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately 890 billion KRW, more than doubling from the previous year, driven by a strong recovery in international travel post-COVID-19. Operating profit turned positive with 15.98 billion KRW, and net profit reached 10.41 billion KRW. The company operates 22 aircraft with increasing utilization rates and has improved its capital structure, reducing debt ratio and increasing equity. It shows a strong growth trajectory aligned with market recovery and strategic expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes safety as its top priority, maintaining an 11-year record without accidents or incidents, and offers superior punctuality through rigorous internal management. It differentiates itself as the dominant regional carrier in Busan/Yeongnam with tailored services and extensive route networks. The introduction of fuel-efficient, next-generation aircraft enables expansion into more profitable mid-to-long-haul routes. Additionally, it enhances customer convenience through diversified ancillary services and innovative in-flight product offerings, reinforcing its position as a customer-centric, efficient low-cost carrier.
